observations.trace: Native CLI declares server_addr as String and setup_initial_client copies it to AdventureSimulatorClient. normalize_server_url preserves any string containing ://; native websocket_config selects TLS only when the normalized string starts with lowercase wss://. On the pinned native path the request URI is parsed by http, whose other-scheme path retains its original bytes, and tokio-tungstenite selects an implicit port only for lowercase ws or wss.
observations.remaining: The example below is source-only and conditional on native feature resolution and the endpoint being supplied. Browser behavior, explicit-port path, actual producer values, proxy policy and network outcomes remain unobserved.

observations.trace: Melee preparation constructs held observations and progress in a local candidate, then publishes the resulting fields only after successful admission. Held elapsed addition can return an overflow; finite positive duration division is clamped before UnitInterval admission, so positive ratio overflow alone is not a rejection. The parent input system already toggles caps before the sprint clock check and can update guard/posture/latches before an attack preparation error; it clears the prior attack edge on both errors.
observations.remaining: A feasible supported overflow input, scheduling between update and send, retained state semantics and atomicity policy are not established. No input system or test ran.

The runtime path validates again and updates a locked clone and version. The historical replication source differs at95e in fixed-tick naming/conversion while retaining the selected landform default rule and building custom codec.
observations.remaining: Multiple app/process lifetime interactions, version/cache timing, all registration consumers, network ordering and external state remain open. Original codec finding remains separately identified.

conditional_findings.first_contract: A supported native server URL should be interpreted consistently across endpoint normalization, transport security choice and the selected WebSocket parser.
conditional_findings.source_witness: Assume a native startup with the CLI server address WSS://example.invalid and no explicit port. The client retains it because it contains ://, and its lowercase prefix check selects Connector::Plain. Pinned http1.5.0 stores an Other scheme with the original WSS bytes; the pinned tokio-tungstenite0.26.2 connect source assigns an implicit port only to exact lowercase ws or wss, so this path returns UnsupportedUrlScheme before its TCP connect if request conversion succeeds. This is a source inference, not a connection attempt.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: Lowercase wss:// selects the default native certificate configuration. The browser path has a separate configuration and WebSocket backend; no browser behavior is inferred. The selected no-port path fails before TLS, so no insecure connection is asserted.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: If uppercase WebSocket schemes are supported input, a native endpoint supplied in that form is rejected. Actual user configuration, feature resolution, explicit ports, upstream normalization and desired case policy remain open.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: Resolve the accepted endpoint syntax and use one admitted/canonical scheme consistently before choosing transport and invoking the native URL consumer. Audit recommendation only.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: Original059 pending question is preserved and partially resolved by current pinned source, not counted as a checkpoint3821 finding or a proven user incident.
